scope: Instrumented Claude-only lease observation on the isolated steven QA pool. A test-only source mutation delays the first qa-claude attempt-0 local build-watcher deadline by 60 seconds while still advertising a five-minute provider lease. The later-attempt deadline and the original work-order expiry check stay unchanged. This tests whether Anthropic re-offers a still-unserved session after the original lease, not clean-main behavior. Only the reviewed, losslessly encoded git diff and redacted evidence will be published; raw work orders and full logs remain private.
